It is right for 39 of 41 groups, so it is NOT loosened; these two state a source outright, the way scripts/ppt/extract_figures.py handles the figure its rules get wrong at both ends. Each pick names WHICH paper and page to read, and how to combine that page's regions. Verified by rendering the page and looking at it - the note records what was seen.
_modes: union = union every figure-sized region on that page (correct only where ONE question owns them all - never assume it; 2025-65-2-2 p6 carries TWO questions' figures and would merge them).  ms = read the figure from the MARKING SCHEME instead of the question paper, locating it by question number; 'band' then trims the result to a fractional y-range because the scheme rasterises the whole question block, text included. Every band below was set by rendering it and looking - the first attempt at a0d77754 clipped its own x-axis tick labels.  padTop = extend the crop UPWARDS by N points to take in a caption, which is page text and therefore outside every image region; it replaces PAD on the top edge instead of adding to it, so measure the gap off the page and pass it as measured.
